entity_raw.source_book_raw: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: Inner Sea Gods
entity_raw.definition_raw:
You cause anyone damaged by your negative energy to become susceptible to poison.

Prerequisite(s): Channel energy 3d6, worshiper of a god of thievery or assassinations.

Benefit(s): Once per day when you channel negative energy to damage living creatures, you can cause any creatures that failed their save against your channel to take a – 4 penalty on saving throws against poison effects. This penalty lasts for 1 minute.
